g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
s and blobs are dropped, and the stored blob URL is never returned.\n- [Set the guest-execution caps](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-
reference/studies/set-the-guest-execution-caps.md): The spend dial for anonymous visitors. A FULL REPLACEMENT. Send every field. T
hese caps only mean something as a set, and a partial update that raised one while leaving another stale would produce a combinati
on nobody chose.\n- [Rotate the share link](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/rotate-the-share-link.md): Mints a new s
hare link and stops the old URL from granting access. Everyone you shared it with needs the new one.\n- [Invite a member](https://
docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/invite-a-member.md): Upsert by email, so re-inviting somebody is not an error. Only meaningf
ul while `mode` is `invited_only`.\n- [Remove a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/remove-a-member.md): Removal
NARROWS access, so it bumps `accessVersion` and cuts off any session that member already had: it takes effect at once rather than
at expiry.\n- [Point a scenario at a different environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/point-a-scenario-at-a-d
ifferent-environment.md): Keeps the study's LINK, its members and its session history while changing what visitors actually reach.
The alternative, unpublish and republish, mints a new link, which means re-sharing it with everyone.\n- [Session metrics](https:/
/docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/session-metrics.md): Volumes, completion and feedback rates over the study's sessions.\n- [
Usage breakdown](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/usage-breakdown.md): Which models, tools and servers the study's se
ssions used.\n- [Current window signals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/current-window-signals.md): What the miner
extracted from the current window, and where you get the window id the insights read takes.\n- [List scenario findings](https://do
cs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-scenario-findings.md): Every finding raised over this study's windows, dismissed ones inc
luded: dismissal is a state on the finding, not a deletion.\n- [Read a window's insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/st
udies/read-a-windows-insights.md): Poll this after requesting a generation.\n- [Request insights for the current window](https://d
ocs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/request-insights-for-the-current-window.md): **No credits are consumed**: the model cost is o
n MCPJam. Runs a model over the study's current window and draws on the organization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUE
STS and is SHARED with eval-run and swarm run insights, so a request here takes one from there.\n- [Cancel a window's generation](
https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/cancel-a-windows-generation.md): Releases a generation that is stuck `pending`. Idem
potent against an already-finished one.\n- [Dismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/dismiss-a-finding.md)
: Keyed on the finding's stable remediation id, so the same problem stays dismissed when insights regenerate. Bodyless: the path n
ames the finding.\n- [Restore a dismissed finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/restore-a-dismissed-finding.md):
Undoes a dismissal. Bodyless: the path names the finding.\n- [Create (or revive) a relay tunnel for a named project server](https:
//docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/create-or-revive-a-relay-tunnel-for-a-named-project-server.md): Registers a server record
named `name` if missing, mints a relay tunnel grant for it, and **persists the tunnel bearer URL (including the plaintext `?k=` se
cret) onto the server record's `url`** so evals and studies can target the tunnel like any remote server. **Every call rotates the
secret, revok…\n- [Revoke a tunnel's live grant](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/revoke-a-tunnels-live-grant.md): R
evokes the grant: the public URL stops working immediately and any live tunnel session is disconnected. The server record, includi
ng its now-dead `url`, is intentionally left untouched, so the next create revives the tunnel with the same slug.\n- [Run one head
less agent turn](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/agent/run-one-headless-agent-turn.md): Runs ONE assistant turn over the sup
plied message history and responds synchronously with the final assistant text, the operations it invoked, references to any resou
rces it created, and any actions awaiting human approval.\n- [Connect an MCP server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-
connections/connect-an-mcp-server.md): Starts a connection request for an MCP server URL. Discovery, browser consent, and validati
on happen asynchronously; poll the returned `connectionRequestId` until the status is terminal. When the next step belongs to a pe
rson, the response carries a `handoffUrl` to open.\n- [Get a connection request](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-conn
ections/get-a-connection-request.md): Current state of one connection request. Metered on its own poll budget rather than the shar
ed per-caller one, so polling on a short interval is expected and will not spend the budget your other calls need. A 429 here mean
s the poll interval itself is too fast; honour Retry-After.\n- [Cancel a connection request](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
/server-connections/cancel-a-connection-request.md): Stops a request and invalidates its handoff link. Cancelling an already-termi
nal request is a no-op.\n- [Retry validation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/retry-validation.md): Re-ar
ms a stalled validation immediately instead of waiting out its backoff. Does not revive a terminal request: after `failed`, `expir
ed`, or `cancelled`, start a new one.\n- [List personas](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-personas.md): The proje
ct's personas, newest first. Archived personas are excluded.\n- [Create a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/cr
eate-a-persona.md): Creates one persona. To draft several with a model first, use `POST /projects/{projectId}/personas/generate`:
that route persists nothing.\n- [Get a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-persona.md): A persona that liv
es in a DIFFERENT project answers 404, never 403: the route is not an existence oracle for a project you cannot see.\n- [Delete a
persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/delete-a-persona.md): Refused with 409 while goals still reference this pers
ona: deleting it would strand them.\n- [Update a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-persona.md): Parti
al update. Goals reference the persona by id, so renaming one does not disturb anything pointing at it.\n- [Draft personas with a
model](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/draft-personas-with-a-model.md): Returns DRAFTS and persists nothing; save the
ones you want with the create routes. There is no idempotency key, and retries return different drafts.\n- [Draft journeys for a
persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/draft-journeys-for-a-persona.md): Returns DRAFTS and persists nothing. See `
POST /projects/{projectId}/personas/generate` for why, and for the quota this counts against.\n- [Get a journey](https://docs.mcpj
am.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-journey.md)\n- [Archive a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/archive-a-journe
y.md): ARCHIVES rather than deletes, and the response says so. Existing runs keep pointing at the definition they executed, so the
ir history stays readable.\n- [Update a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-journey.md): Editing a goal
never disturbs a run already under way: a run pins its own immutable snapshot of the definition at launch.\n- [List swarms](https
://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-swarms.md)\n- [Create a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-
swarm.md): A swarm is an authoring container holding DEFAULTS for the goals made under it. Creating one starts nothing.\n- [Get a
swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-swarm.md)\n- [Archive a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swa
rms/archive-a-swarm.md): ARCHIVES the container. The goals authored under it are not touched: they keep their own definitions and
stay launchable.\n- [Update a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-swarm.md): Changes the container's DEFA
